facts.text: Islamabad is the planned national capital.
Pakistan has an Arabian Sea coast.
Mohenjo-daro and Harappa preserve remains of ancient civilizations.

culture.text: Urdu, Punjabi, Pashto, Sindhi, Balochi, and other languages reflect Pakistan’s cultural diversity.

food.name: Nihari
food.text: Beef or mutton is simmered for hours in a seasoned gravy and commonly eaten with bread.
